title: Claim the Sídhe Mound Descent: Outer Line
description: Claim the Sídhe Mound Descent: Outer Line is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate (Sealed Gate with fae time bleed). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Dagda, Morrígan, Brigid, Lugh enters; this beat spotlights Lugh as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the combat step at Sídhe Mound Descent, using living mound-gate maze and geas trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: Avalora is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy. This mission takes place in The Infernal Dominion — the avatar ventures beyond their home realm to confront threats and establish influence in foreign territory.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Sídhe Mound Descent and reveals: Why forbidden actions trigger living thorns. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: The Infernal Dominion — enemy territory. black-iron debt courts, lava-fissured caverns, obsidian spires, hellfire chasms, chain-wrapped pillars, shadow-bleeding walls, sulfur-lit passages. Avatar fights at reduced power (realm penalty applies).
